styles.description_fa: نور استودیویی، بافت واقعی، حس فروشگاه آنلاین.
styles.preview_prompt: photoreal commercial product photography, studio lighting, sharp detail, realistic materials
styles.visual_grammar: Clean believable photography, accurate materials, controlled lighting, intentional commercial composition.
styles.composition_tendencies: Product-dominant hero with an intentional environment, not a default dead-center studio still.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Controlled key and fill, soft shadows, commercial clarity.
styles.material_rendering: True surface texture, glass, metal, fabric, and packaging print.
styles.color_behavior: Faithful product color with a refined commercial palette.
weak_for: making every result a centered blank-studio still
styles.prompt_guidance: Shoot as professional real-world product advertising. Keep materials and color accurate. Give the product a designed environment and camera, not a generic seamless backdrop unless the brief truly needs it.

styles.description_fa: ژست و ترکیب‌بندی مجله‌ای، نور سینمایی.
styles.preview_prompt: high-fashion editorial photography, magazine lighting, stylish composition, cinematic grade
styles.visual_grammar: Intentional posing, asymmetry, crop, styling, magazine-quality lighting, strong visual attitude.
styles.composition_tendencies: Human/lifestyle first. Avoid catalog ecommerce centering.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Editorial key, rim, and contrast. Magazine, not shop lighting.
styles.material_rendering: Fabric drape, jewellery sparkle, skin, and accessory detail.
styles.color_behavior: Art-directed grade that still preserves product color identity.
styles.prompt_guidance: This must look like fashion/lifestyle art direction, not generic ecommerce photography. Prefer a person, pose, crop, and attitude. Do not degrade into a centered product packshot unless there is a specific conceptual editorial reason.

styles.description_fa: خط تمیز، رنگ‌های زنده، حس انیمیشن مدرن.
styles.preview_prompt: modern anime still, clean linework, vivid cel shading, expressive lighting, not a screenshot
styles.visual_grammar: Clean line work, cel shading, expressive environments or characters, intentionally illustrated.
styles.composition_tendencies: Illustrated scene or character with the product integrated, never a live-action screenshot.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Graphic cel light, colored rims, clear shadow shapes.
styles.material_rendering: Stylized but the real product silhouette, colors, and graphics stay identifiable.
styles.color_behavior: Vivid controlled palettes, not muddy photoreal.
weak_for: text-heavy packaging that must stay photographic
styles.prompt_guidance: Make a contemporary anime-inspired advertising illustration. Keep linework and cel shading obvious. Preserve packaging/logos as faithfully as illustration allows. No screenshot UI, no fake speech or lettering.

styles.description_fa: جوهر، هاشور و حس صفحه کمیک.
styles.preview_prompt: illustrated manga-inspired artwork, ink linework, screentone texture, graphic poster composition, no speech bubbles, no lettering
styles.visual_grammar: Ink, screentone, graphic framing, dynamic black/white or limited-color structure.
styles.composition_tendencies: Poster-like graphic frames, speed, contrast, not a painted photoreal still.
styles.material_rendering: Graphic reduction of the product while keeping silhouette and key graphics.
styles.color_behavior: Black/white or a tight limited palette.
styles.prompt_guidance: Graphic manga-inspired commercial illustration. Use ink and screentone. No speech bubbles, no fake lettering, no invented manga text. Product identity must survive the graphic reduction.

styles.preview_prompt: polished 3D product render, soft studio HDRI, physically based materials, octane-like quality without naming a renderer
styles.visual_grammar: Physically convincing materials, sculpted forms, studio/CG lighting, controlled geometry.
styles.composition_tendencies: Object visualization, plinths, levitation, scale play. Weak for worn clothing on people.
styles.lighting_tendencies: HDRI studio, specular control, clean CG falloff.
styles.material_rendering: PBR plastics, rubber, metal, glass. Packaging type is high-risk.
styles.color_behavior: Product-true color with premium CG polish.
styles.prompt_guidance: Premium stylized 3D product visualization. Sculpted form and studio CG light. Do not name a renderer. Preserve silhouette and color; be careful with packaging type. Avoid forcing a photoreal human wearing the product.

styles.description_fa: بافت دست‌ساز و حجم نرم خمیر.
styles.preview_prompt: claymation still, handmade clay texture, soft studio light, tactile miniature craft look
styles.visual_grammar: Soft sculpted forms, handcrafted imperfections, miniature physical-world feeling.
styles.composition_tendencies: Tactile object or miniature world. Weak for realistic people wearing clothes.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Soft tabletop light, gentle shadows, craft-set atmosphere.
styles.material_rendering: Clay, fingerprint scale, handmade edges. Fine print is high-risk.
styles.color_behavior: Slightly simplified product colors in clay pigment.
styles.prompt_guidance: Handmade tactile clay / miniature craft aesthetic. Keep the product silhouette readable. Do not turn a real person into a clay fashion model unless the template absolutely requires a figure and even then keep the product identifiable.

styles.description_fa: لایه‌های بریده، کاغذ و بافت چاپی.
styles.preview_prompt: paper collage advertisement still, cut-paper layers, print texture, graphic overlapping shapes, no readable text
styles.visual_grammar: Cutouts, layered paper, print textures, graphic shapes, bold composition.
styles.composition_tendencies: Photographic product cutout inside a transformed paper world.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Graphic paper lighting, printed shadows, collage depth.
styles.material_rendering: Keep real product pixels when possible; transform only the environment.
styles.color_behavior: Bold print palettes around faithful product color.
weak_for: muddy photoreal studio shots with a slight paper overlay
styles.prompt_guidance: Graphic cut-paper/editorial collage. Preserve the real product as a photographic cutout while transforming the environment into layered paper and print texture. No readable collage lettering.

styles.preview_prompt: surreal advertising still, dreamlike scale, unexpected environment, cinematic color, grounded product identity
styles.visual_grammar: Dreamlike scale or environment, impossible but intentional relationship between product and scene.
styles.composition_tendencies: One readable impossible idea. Do not force surrealism onto every product.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Motivated strange light that still describes the product.
styles.material_rendering: Product stays physically itself inside an impossible world.
styles.prompt_guidance: Conceptual advertising with unexpected physical logic. The impossible relationship must be immediately readable. Do not merely grade a normal studio shot. Keep the real SKU recognizable.

styles.description_fa: نور فیلم، عمق میدان و حس سکانس.
styles.preview_prompt: cinematic still, anamorphic atmosphere, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, filmic color
styles.visual_grammar: Narrative environment, motivated light, depth, atmosphere, intentional camera, sense of moment.
styles.composition_tendencies: A scene with story, not a studio packshot with cinematic LUTs.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Motivated practicals, volume, depth, film contrast.
styles.material_rendering: Photoreal materials inside a filmic world.
styles.color_behavior: Filmic grade that still preserves product identity.
styles.prompt_guidance: Cinematic is a scene, not a color grade. Require narrative atmosphere, motivated light, depth, and an intentional camera. The product stays legible. Do not deliver a centered studio hero with teal-and-orange grading.

styles.description_fa: رنگ و بافت دهه‌های گذشته، بدون کپی اثر مشخص.
styles.preview_prompt: retro commercial still, vintage color film, analog grain, period lighting, no logos, no lettering
styles.visual_grammar: Specific vintage photographic or print behavior, period palette, grain, lighting, composition.
styles.composition_tendencies: Period-commercial framing. Must be visibly retro, not a slight warm filter.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Analog era lighting: tungsten, flash, or print-era softness.
styles.material_rendering: Film grain and print texture over true product form.
styles.color_behavior: Period palette, shifted but product still identifiable.
weak_for: a modern photo with a vintage LUT only
styles.prompt_guidance: Recognizable period-commercial / analog visual language. It must look retro, not merely warm. Do not reference copyrighted brands or named campaigns. No invented lettering.

styles.description_fa: رنگ دانه، کاغذ مرطوب و حس نقاشی.
styles.preview_prompt: watercolor illustration, pigment blooms, paper texture, hand-painted advertising still, no lettering
styles.visual_grammar: Paper texture, pigment variation, brush/pigment edges, painterly environment.
styles.composition_tendencies: Hand-painted scene around a still-identifiable product.
styles.material_rendering: Pigment stands in for materials; silhouette and key colors must survive.
styles.color_behavior: Soft blooms, paper white, product-true local color.
styles.prompt_guidance: Hand-painted soft advertising illustration. Show paper, pigment, and brush edges. Environment is painted. Product identity stays readable. No lettering.

styles.description_fa: شب شهری، نور نئون و کنتراست بالا.
styles.preview_prompt: neon night commercial still, saturated rim light, wet reflections, high contrast, no signage lettering
styles.visual_grammar: Colored rim lights, emissive environmental lighting, dark/night environment, reflections, contrast.
styles.composition_tendencies: Night commercial energy. Avoid random neon signage text.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Saturated rims, wet bounce, dark surround, product still readable.
styles.material_rendering: Highlights and reflections on real materials.
styles.color_behavior: Emissive accents around faithful product color.
styles.prompt_guidance: High-energy night commercial visual. Colored rims and dark environment. No random neon signage or readable signs. Product remains the hero.

styles.description_fa: الگوی ایرانی، رنگ تخت و ترکیب تزئینی — نه کپی یک اثر.
styles.preview_prompt: contemporary advertising still inspired by Persian miniature patterning, ornamental flat color, garden geometry, no calligraphy, no readable text
styles.visual_grammar: Ornamental geometry, flattened perspective, garden/architectural motifs, decorative framing, controlled flat color.
styles.composition_tendencies: Compositionally inspired by miniature art, not merely a decorative border around a photo.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Even decorative illumination, little photoreal depth fog.
styles.material_rendering: Stylized planes; product silhouette and colors stay specific.
styles.prompt_guidance: Contemporary commercial composition inspired by Persian miniature visual principles. Flattened ornamental space and garden/architecture motifs. Must feel compositionally inspired, not a photo with a pretty border. No fake calligraphy.

styles.description_fa: ترکیب پوستر میان‌قرن، بافت چاپ سنگی — نه بازسازی یک پوستر معروف.
styles.preview_prompt: vintage Iranian poster-inspired graphic still, mid-century print texture, bold flat shapes, limited palette, no lettering, no logos
styles.visual_grammar: Flat graphic shapes, print texture, limited palette, bold poster composition, period commercial illustration.
styles.composition_tendencies: A real poster-like composition even without type, not a product photo with texture overlay.
styles.lighting_tendencies: Graphic print shading, not cinematic photography.
styles.material_rendering: Reduced graphic shapes that still identify the SKU.
weak_for: copied historical logos, posters, or characters
styles.prompt_guidance: Mid-century Iranian commercial-poster-inspired visual language. Flat shapes, print texture, bold poster composition. It must become a poster, not a normal product image with grain. No copied historical logos, posters, or characters. No lettering.

templates.description_fa: محصول در مرکز، واضح و بزرگ.
templates.preview_prompt: hero product centered, large in frame, clean supporting environment
templates.composition_goal: One unmistakable product hero occupying roughly 45–70% of useful visual area with an intentional supporting environment.
templates.camera_behavior: Choose the camera that best shows defining product geometry. Not obligated to be dead-center on a blank backdrop.
templates.product_placement: Hero placement with designed negative space for type.
templates.foreground_behavior: Minimal; nothing competing with the product.
templates.background_behavior: Intentional environment or set, not leftover generic white.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Clear empty band for overlay type, usually bottom.
templates.prompt_guidance: One unmistakable product hero. It must not mean always centering an object on a generic blank background. Design the environment and camera around the product.

templates.description_fa: یک نفر محصول را پوشیده یا استفاده می‌کند.
templates.preview_prompt: one person using or wearing the product naturally, product clearly visible, editorial body language
templates.composition_goal: Show a person naturally wearing or using the product with a plausible person-product relationship.
templates.camera_behavior: Body and product both readable. Apparel: fit, silhouette, front graphic visible.
templates.product_scale: Product remains visually important, not lost on the body.
templates.product_placement: Worn or used in a physically plausible way.
templates.foreground_behavior: Hands/body may frame the product but must not hide it.
templates.background_behavior: Lifestyle or editorial setting that supports the pose.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Keep a type band away from the face and product graphic.
weak_for: tiny objects with no plausible use pose
templates.prompt_guidance: A person must naturally wear or use this exact product. Apparel fit and front graphic stay visible. Beauty use must make sense. Accessories must not disappear behind the model. No extra SKUs.

templates.description_fa: محصول روی استند یا سطح نمایش.
templates.preview_prompt: product displayed on a pedestal or plinth, museum-like presentation, dramatic but simple set
templates.composition_goal: Elevated premium object presentation on a designed plinth or pedestal.
templates.camera_behavior: Slightly low or three-quarter to honor the plinth geometry.
templates.product_placement: On a distinct plinth/stand with intentional set design.
templates.foreground_behavior: Plinth edge and maybe a simple foreground accent.
templates.background_behavior: Designed set, not empty infinity unless the set is the void.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Often top or side, away from the plinth.
templates.prompt_guidance: The product sits on a designed plinth/pedestal. Geometry and set design matter. This is not a floating object and not a blank table.

templates.description_fa: ترکیب جلد، با فضای خالی برای تیتر آفرین.
templates.preview_prompt: magazine-cover composition, strong vertical layout, generous empty area for overlay type, no masthead, no cover lines
templates.composition_goal: Vertical editorial-cover composition designed for later typography.
templates.camera_behavior: Cover camera: subject hierarchy, not a catalog packshot.
templates.product_scale: Strong but leaves deliberate type zones.
templates.product_placement: Cover subject placement with clear hierarchy.
templates.background_behavior: Graphic or photographic cover world. No generated masthead.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Generous empty type zones, usually top, as if a cover without letters.
weak_for: busy clutter with no type zone
templates.prompt_guidance: It must visually feel like a magazine cover even without text. Strong subject, hierarchy, and type zones. No generated masthead or cover lines.

templates.description_fa: محصول غول‌پیکر در یک دنیای مینیاتوری.
templates.preview_prompt: giant product standing in a miniature city or landscape, playful forced perspective, one product only
templates.composition_goal: The product is monumental relative to a clearly miniature world with visible scale cues.
templates.camera_behavior: Forced perspective that reads giant-vs-tiny immediately.
templates.product_placement: Standing in or looming over the miniature world.
templates.foreground_behavior: Miniature cues in the foreground: tiny streets, figures, vehicles, or landscape.
templates.background_behavior: A real miniature world, not a generic backdrop with a large object.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a type band that does not hide scale cues.
weak_for: enlarging an object against empty space with no cues
templates.prompt_guidance: Not simply a large product. The environment must contain unmistakable miniature scale cues. One product only.

templates.preview_prompt: product placed in a cinematic environment, wide establishing atmosphere, product still readable
templates.composition_goal: Place the product in a narrative, film-like environment that matters to the story.
templates.camera_behavior: Intentional cinematic camera, depth, not a studio lock-off with a LUT.
templates.product_scale: Legible hero inside a larger scene.
templates.product_placement: Integrated into the environment, still findable.
templates.foreground_behavior: Depth layers that do not hide the product.
templates.background_behavior: A real scene with atmosphere. Not a cyclorama.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Use sky, wall, or ground negative space for type.
weak_for: studio product shot with cinematic color grading
templates.prompt_guidance: Environment is part of the story. This is not a studio product shot with cinematic color grading. Product remains legible.

templates.description_fa: شناور در فضا، نور از اطراف.
templates.preview_prompt: product floating in mid-air, elegant levitation, controlled motion blur optional, empty background space for type
templates.composition_goal: Intentional levitating product with clear separation from ground and beautiful spatial logic.
templates.camera_behavior: Stable elegant view, not random tumbling.
templates.product_placement: Clearly off the ground, supported by designed spatial cues.
templates.foreground_behavior: Optional particles or light, not clutter.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Empty space around the float for type.
templates.prompt_guidance: Levitation must feel designed. Clear separation from ground, believable spatial logic, controlled supporting elements. Avoid random object rotation.

templates.preview_prompt: overhead flat lay, arranged related props, product as the clear hero, top-down camera
templates.composition_goal: True top-down composition with intentional arrangement around the product.
templates.camera_behavior: Near-overhead. Do not produce angled hero photography.
templates.foreground_behavior: Props on the same plane, relevant and subordinate.
templates.background_behavior: Surface texture that supports the category.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: A clean band on the surface for type.
templates.prompt_guidance: Genuine overhead composition. Props relevant and subordinate. Do not fake a flat lay with an angled camera.

templates.description_fa: شخصیت یا مدل به‌عنوان پوستر کمپین.
templates.preview_prompt: character poster composition, one figure, product integrated into the pose, empty type band, no poster text
templates.composition_goal: One person/character integrated into a strong poster composition with the product.
templates.camera_behavior: Poster camera, figure as campaign character, product meaningfully incorporated.
templates.product_scale: Product must be meaningfully visible in the poster.
templates.product_placement: Held, worn, or designed into the figure.
templates.foreground_behavior: Poster graphic foreground ok, no lettering.
templates.background_behavior: Poster world with a clear later-type region.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Keep a clear later-type region. No generated poster lettering.
weak_for: object-only products with no human role
templates.prompt_guidance: Requires a human figure. Product must be meaningfully incorporated. Poster composition with a type region. No generated poster lettering.

templates.preview_prompt: illustrated scene around the product, supporting environment drawn in the chosen style, product remains the subject
templates.composition_goal: Product integrated into an intentionally illustrated world that is a real scene, not a decorative border.
templates.camera_behavior: Scene camera matching the illustration style.
templates.product_scale: Subject of the scene, still dominant.
templates.product_placement: Inside the illustrated world; photo product cutout allowed if the style supports it.
templates.foreground_behavior: Illustrated foreground that belongs to the scene.
templates.background_behavior: A drawn environment, not a frame or sticker border.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Painted or drawn empty region for type.
weak_for: photoreal commercial that should stay photographic
templates.prompt_guidance: The environment is a real illustrated scene. Can combine a preserved/photo product with illustrated surroundings. Not a decorative border around a packshot.

templates.description_fa: محصول میان وسایل مرتبط با کاربردش.
templates.preview_prompt: product surrounded by relevant lifestyle props, balanced still-life, no extra product variants
templates.composition_goal: Commercial still-life where carefully chosen relevant props support the product story.
templates.camera_behavior: Still-life camera that keeps the product dominant.
templates.product_placement: Hero among props that communicate category, use, or mood.
templates.foreground_behavior: A few relevant props, no random clutter.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clean area not filled with props.
templates.prompt_guidance: Props must communicate category, use, or mood. Avoid random clutter. Product remains dominant. No extra product variants.

templates.description_fa: محصول خیلی بزرگ یا خیلی کوچک در فضا.
templates.preview_prompt: surreal scale shift, product impossibly large or tiny in a real environment, one product only
templates.composition_goal: One deliberate impossible scale relationship that is immediately readable.
templates.camera_behavior: Camera that makes the scale joke or wonder obvious.
templates.product_scale: Impossibly large or tiny versus a real environment.
templates.product_placement: In an environment that proves the scale.
templates.foreground_behavior: Scale witnesses: people, buildings, furniture, landscape.
templates.background_behavior: A real-world context that makes the impossibility readable.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Type away from the scale comparison.
weak_for: merely resizing the product with no environmental context
templates.prompt_guidance: One deliberate impossible scale relationship. Immediately readable. Product identity remains recognizable. Do not merely change product size without environmental context.
